slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is there any constraint linking purchases and sales within the same month, such as a requirement that you must sell at least as much as you buy, or that sales can only come from beginning inventory (not from the same month's purchases)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched intra-month purchase/sale timing by asking whether sales can use same-month purchases, but did not explicitly ask whether purchases occur at the beginning of the month or otherwise clarify the timing of purchases within the month.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Purchases and sales within a month can be treated via an end-of-month inventory balance, with no separate intra-month timing or capacity peak.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never explicitly confirmed whether purchases occur at the beginning of the month; the READY_TO_MODEL model uses only end-of-month inventory balance and capacity constraints.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent stopped at READY_TO_MODEL while the P1 hidden slot about purchase timing within the month was not fully resolved; it only partially addressed intra-month linkage and then assumed an end-of-month inventory formulation.

summary: The agent asked many useful clarifying questions and resolved most modeling details, but it only partially addressed the timing of purchases within the month and then silently assumed an end-of-month inventory formulation, leaving a P1 hidden slot unresolved at READY_TO_MODEL.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
